outcome: Arterial stiffness (heart rate corrected augmentation index [AIx75], central pulse pressure [CPP], pulse wave velocity [PWV])
cohort: The study included women who experienced spontaneous preterm delivery (GA ≤ 34 weeks) and matched controls who experienced term delivery (GA ≥ 39 weeks).
finding: Women with spontaneous preterm delivery showed no significant change in arterial stiffness (AIx75) at 6 months postpartum, unlike women with term delivery who demonstrated significant decreases.
gest_age: Mean GA for sPTD was 30.8 weeks (<= 34 weeks), and for controls was 39.6 weeks (>= 39 weeks).
